verdict.rationale: Extend supports batch-like operations via multifile extraction (run over a collection of files with shared context), async processing endpoints for extract/classify/split/parse/edit, and evaluation set runs that score a processor against every item in a set — all pointing to bulk/batch capability across many documents. However, there's no explicit documentation of a bulk API endpoint for arbitrary large-scale item batches, rate limits/throughput guarantees, or dedicated bulk-operations tooling beyond these features. missing for 10: dedicated bulk-operation API/endpoint documentation, throughput/scale guarantees, independent hands-on evidence of large-scale bulk runs.
